sloka: ततो हतान् राक्षसपुङ्गवांस्तान् देवान्तकादित्रिशिरोतिकायान्।रक्षोगणास्तत्र हतावशिष्टास्ते रावणाय त्वरितं शशंसुः ।। ६.७३.१ ।।
transliteration: tato hatān rākṣasapuṅgavāṁstān devāntakāditriśirotikāyān।rakṣogaṇāstatra hatāvaśiṣṭāste rāvaṇāya tvaritaṁ śaśaṁsuḥ ।। 6.73.1 ।।

translations.english: Then the Rakshasas who survived the killings, hurriedly reported to the Rakshasa king, Ravana about the killing of Devanthaka, Trisira and Atikaya.
